lines: Stafford played 100% of snaps over his last 3 games, but threw 31.3 passes per game, down from 37.2 for the season.
He averaged 13.1 PPR points per game over those 3 games, with 211.3 passing yards and 1.7 touchdown passes per game.
LA has a bye in Wk 11. The coach said Stafford will lean on quick throws and pass protection against Arizona's pressure.
